scripts.build: pnpm --filter @atape/adapter-codex build && pnpm --filter @atape/cli build && pnpm --filter @atape/web build
scripts.check: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm --filter @atape/web test:browser && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:go
scripts.generate:sqlc: cd server && go run github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc/cmd/sqlc@v1.29.0 generate
scripts.test:release: pnpm test:cli-package && pnpm test:adapter-package && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
scripts.test:go:integration: cd server && ATAPE_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 TESTCONTAINERS_RYUK_DISABLED=true go test ./internal/adapters/postgres ./internal/adapters/httpapi ./internal/authentication ./internal/authcutover ./internal/team -count=1
scripts.test:security:dependencies: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high && cd server && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.14 go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...
